'''Jestra Andrim''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who was a member of [[House Andrim]], a [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] house. At some point during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], House Andrim sent an operative to the [[Belgaroth system/Legends|Belgaroth system]], to [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on some weapons tests that were to be performed by the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] ''[[Burning Vengeance]]'' and [[Legacy (Star Destroyer)|''Legacy'']]. To collect the data that their operative had recovered, Jestra approached a group of agents that were stopping over on Kuat and requested that they perform a courier mission for her. She then invited the agents to an evening party in House Andrim's manor on the surface of Kuat, where she discussed with them the details of the assignment, then dispatched them to the Belgaroth [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds" />
